title: Import the full EPP content corpus
decision: Archivist should contain the full EPP content corpus for this migration, not only a small seed subset.
context: The user wants the EPP manual to remain the first serious proving workspace because its full corpus contains the edge cases needed to shape Archivist, especially Appendix A and other appendix/tool documents.
rationale: A tiny seed is useful for scaffolding, but it hides navigation, renderer, compliance, source, appendix, and artifact cases that will determine whether Archivist is actually useful for policy work.
alternatives_considered: Keep only a small seed workspace until the app shell is complete
Open the original EPP repo externally instead of importing content into Archivist
Copy only selected high-value EPP files
consequences: Full-content import must be repeatable so the workspace can be refreshed from the old EPP repo
The full EPP workspace must include project metadata and source references, not just Markdown bodies
The app can keep the seed workspace for fast scaffold testing while using the full workspace for parity and edge-case work
Appendix A and other interactive artifacts become migration drivers rather than deferred oddities
